PagerBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed across inference gateway in us-east-1. Error surge started ~5m ago. Severity: P1. Paging on-call group now.
Lina (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs + current queue depth. anyone already looking at batching metrics?
Marc (runtime): seeing queue backlog building on scheduler shards 3-6. batch windows are at 150ms and backlog depth hit 18k requests. head-of-line blocking on requests with huge prompt tokens.
Sasha (eng-sre): confirming high HOL. KV-cache growth also spiking which is increasing eviction thrash. Latency tail > 10s, gateway 502s.
Lina (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) short-term reduce batch window to 20ms 2) enable per-client rate-limit fallback 3) route new traffic to backup model pool in other region 4) start canary draining of overloaded scheduler nodes.
DevOps (ops): I can push a config change to disable batching on the gateway traffic path for the hottest routes. Command ready:
```
# reduce batch window and temporarily disable large-batching
rctl set scheduler.batch_window_ms 20 --env=prod-us-east-1
rctl set scheduler.enable_large_batches false --env=prod-us-east-1
```
Marc (runtime): do it. also add quick evict for single-request queues older than 8s:
```
runtimectl set eviction.hol_threshold_ms 8000 --shards=3-6
```
Lina (oncall): applying both now. tell me when the config flip is complete. Eva, ping CS that we may see request failures for ~2-4 minutes while we reroute.
Eva (support): pinged CS w/ template: "We are mitigating a routing/backpressure issue causing intermittent 5xx/timeouts in US-EAST. Engineering has applied temporary routing and batching changes; customers may see transient errors for a few minutes. We'll update as mitigation progresses."
OpsBot: config change acknowledged. Rolling update to scheduler config in prod-us-east-1. 6 nodes targeted.
Sasha (eng-sre): seeing immediate drop in queue depth on shards 3 and 4. HOL tail decreasing. Gateway 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 4% within 90s.
Marc (runtime): KV-cache growth slowed after eviction tweak. But overall request throughput fell ~10% after disabling large batches — cost up but latency tails improved.
Lina (oncall): Good — next steps: 1) keep batching disabled for hot routes for 30m 2) start controlled re-enable with reduced max batch size and per-req token caps 3) open page to infra to consider autoscaling more scheduler shards if traffic persists.
Sasha (eng-sre): Opening infra page now, recommending immediate +4 scheduler pods and increase max threads per pod.
DevOps (ops): Autoscale request submitted: `infractl scale scheduler-prod-us-east-1 +4 --reason "backpressure mitigation"`
OpsBot: Scale job queued. ETA ~2m.
Marc (runtime): Also preparing a longer-term fix: patch to prefer short-running requests first (age-aware scheduler) to avoid HOL from huge prompts. Planning a canary tomorrow.
Lina (oncall): Customer impact: some API requests returned 502/504 or timed out during peak. Percent of affected requests peaked at ~14% for 3 minutes, now down to ~2%. CS notified.
Eva (support): customers who reported errors: customer-a (high priority), customer-b. Escalated to CE for both.
Sasha (eng-sre): Monitoring — setting an alert to auto-suppress large-batch windows when queue depth > 8k to avoid recurrence.
Lina (oncall): Summarizing for postmortem: root cause = batching scheduler saturation due to sudden influx of long-token requests plus KV-cache growth causing eviction thrash -> head-of-line blocking -> gateway timeouts. Mitigations = reduce batch window, disable large batches for hot routes, set HOL eviction threshold, scale scheduler pods, reroute traffic to backup pools. Follow-ups: age-aware scheduling, token caps, autoscale policy for backlog.
Marc (runtime): I'll take the follow-up tickets for age-aware scheduler + canary. Sasha, add ops autoscale policy changes.
Sasha (eng-sre): Roger. I'll also draft runbook entries for "conga-line" HOL — include quick commands used here.
Lina (oncall): Closing live mitigation. Will keep thread open for postmortem notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
PagerBot: Incident resolved (P1 -> monitoring) at ts 3154210120. Metrics continue to recover.
